card.reasoning: Rank and condition number are measured once on pre-cutoff rows; the preprocessing fitted for this measurement is not saved. Fields that are always missing together give identical missing indicators, so the 4.3 duplicate rule is applied to the encoded columns inside each training fold (factory step 'dedupe'); the linear/logistic matrix is then full rank. The tree recipe keeps every one-hot level, so its matrix is rank-deficient by design, which does not affect trees.
